en.headline: Hong Kong team takes record 15 awards at WorldSkills Shanghai
en.dek: MTR technician Tang Kwong-tai won silver in railway vehicle technology as the 41-member team finished with one silver and 14 medallions of excellence.
body: Hong Kong competitors collected a record 15 awards at the 2026 WorldSkills Competition in Shanghai, which ended on Sunday, the Vocational Training Council said. The team of 41 athletes contested 37 skills, the city’s largest entry to date.

Tang Kwong-tai, an MTR technician and graduate of the Hong Kong Institute of Vocational Education, won silver in railway vehicle technology and was named the team’s best competitor. The remaining 14 awards were medallions of excellence across skills including cybersecurity, concrete construction, hairdressing, welding and pastry.

Secretary for Education Choi Yuk-lin attended the closing events in Shanghai and said the results showed the ability of young people in vocational and professional education. VTC chairman Lam Kin-fung said the medal haul was the largest in Hong Kong’s WorldSkills history.

The biennial contest, organised by WorldSkills International, drew about 1,400 competitors from some 70 members across 64 skills. Since first taking part in 1997, Hong Kong has accumulated four golds, three silvers, seven bronzes and 95 medallions of excellence.

zh.headline: 世界技能大賽港隊奢15獎創歷屆新高
zh.dek: 港鐵技術員鄧光大在軌道車輛技術項目奪銀並獲選最佳選手，港隊另添14個優異獎章。
body: 職業訓練局表示，2026年世界技能大賽周日在上海結束，中國香港隊共奢15個獎項，數目創歷屆新高。港隊今屆派出41名選手出戰37個項目，規模為歷來最大。
港鐵技術員、香港專業教育學院畢業生鄧光大在軌道車輛技術項目奪得銀牌，並獲選為港隊最佳選手。其餘14個獎項為優異獎章，涵蓋網絡安全、混凝土建築、美髮、焊接及西點製作等項目。
教育局局長蔡若蓮在上海出席閉幕活動，指成績展現職業專才教育年輕人的能力。職訓局主席林健鋒表示，今屆獎項數目是港隊參賽以來最多。
兩年一度的大賽由世界技能組織舉辦，今屆約70個成員國及地區、約1400名選手競逐64個項目。香港自1997年首次參賽以來，累積4金、3銀、7銅及95個優異獎章。
